content:
#83 I agree with #81. The nCafé and the nForum are at least historically connected. The CT Zulip is wholly independent.

I see no problem with reporting spam here. People can ignore this thread if they want to. It’s one thread among many that only sees very sporadic activity. Posting a comment at the Café about a spammer was presumably seen as too-public an activity, too close to the action. the nForum was a back channel for alerting people with site-editing powers, who were regulars here as well as there. Emailing an individual can be too slow, and also puts the onus on the individual, and can lead to duplication of notifications. A group posting that’s visible means: 1) people have noticed the spam, no one else need report it, 2) any one of the people with the power to deal with it can deal with it if they choose, and 3) the removal can be noted, if desired, to prevent more back-and-forth.

I don’t know of another place that’s better suited than here for that purpose.
